details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that reports each install to a callback host. Its postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, and its index.js also invokes the same beacon when the module is loaded, sending an HTTP POST of JSON {package, hostname, installPath, cwd, userAgent} to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. The README self-declares the package as an authorized dependency-confusion test whose only action is reporting that it was installed. The beacon collects host and install-path metadata only — no credentials, environment values, tokens or file contents — and the package contains no other executable payload.
